from __future__ import annotations
import csv
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import math
p=Path('/Users/doob/dev/energy_forecast_ws/94eee4/project/runs/94eee4/opsd_de_load.csv')
rows=[]
with p.open(newline='') as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        t=datetime.fromisoformat(row['utc_timestamp'])
        raw=row['DE_load_actual_entsoe_transparency']
        y=float(raw) if raw else math.nan
        rows.append((t,y))
print('rows',len(rows))
print('start',rows[0][0].isoformat(),'end',rows[-1][0].isoformat())
print('missing values',sum(math.isnan(y) for _,y in rows))
print('duplicate timestamps',len(rows)-len({t for t,_ in rows}))
missing_ts=[]
expected=rows[0][0]
for t,_ in rows:
    while expected<t:
        missing_ts.append(expected)
        expected += timedelta(hours=1)
    expected=t+timedelta(hours=1)
print('missing timestamps',len(missing_ts), [t.isoformat() for t in missing_ts[:10]])
print('last rows')
for t,y in rows[-12:]: print(t.isoformat(), y)
by_year=defaultdict(list)
for t,y in rows:
    if not math.isnan(y): by_year[t.year].append(y)
for year, vals in sorted(by_year.items()):
    print(year,len(vals),round(sum(vals)/len(vals),1),min(vals),max(vals))
